prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity desktop WEB APPLICATION screen for MediSummarize AI, edge to edge, landscape approximately 1440 by 1000 pixels. No browser frame, device, desk, photograph, abstract art, marketing hero, ornamental texture, fake charts, or large empty areas. This is a working medical-document review app, standard web controls, extremely polished aligned spacing, crisp legible 16px body text and clear hierarchy.
Real content throughout: product name MediSummarize AI; navigation Records, Experiments, Demo guide, System. Current fictional record DEMO-001, badge Synthetic demo. Heading Review the record. Primary Upload documents button. Small honest notice "Mock generation · Verify all output against sources". Tabs Documents and Summary & evidence with Summary & evidence active.
Document list contains discharge-note.pdf, status Extracted, 2 pages, and prescription.png, status Needs review, 1 page.
Summary pane heading Draft summary and badge Mock output. Body: "Fever and sore throat documented in the discharge note. Follow-up advice requires source verification." Adjacent citation button [1].
Source pane heading Source evidence; filename discharge-note.pdf · Page 1. Show a short clearly fictional document excerpt: "SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Patient reports fever and sore throat for two days. Advised follow-up if symptoms persist." Highlight the matching fever sentence with a light selection tint and margin source anchor [1]. Include Open source page action.
At the lower part of this same screen show a compact Experiment runs area with View experiments link and a semantic table Model / Dataset / Status / CER. Rows Tesseract / RxHandBD v3 / Not run / —; Pretrained TrOCR-small / RxHandBD v3 / Not run / —; Fine-tuned TrOCR-small / RxHandBD v3 / Not run / —. Small caption "Training runs in Kaggle. Import results after evaluation." These are planned experiments, NEVER display fabricated performance numbers, accuracy claims, patient names, graphs with invented scores, or real medical data. The mockup is a proposed interface with synthetic content, not a claim of completed experiments.
World contributes only palette, type, density, and one source-link signature move. Layout, navigation, forms, buttons and tabs must be familiar web application controls. A refined product screen that an engineer can implement in React.
Composition: full-width ink top navigation instead of sidebar, product left, Records/Experiments/Demo guide/System centered, account right. Under it a flat ivory workspace, compact record heading left and Upload documents right, then tabs. A 230px left document list and two reading panes side by side filling remaining width, generous vertical measure. Experiment table is a lower full-width band. World: annotated reference typography translated into STANDARD WEB APPLICATION, iron-black #24231f, flat bone #f3f0e7, nearwhite #fffefa, vermilion #af4435 used for selected sources and primary action. UI uses clear neutral sans; source excerpt uses highly readable medium-size serif. One-pixel rules, square or 3px corners, no paper grain, no faux book or newspaper. Signature: matching vermilion bracket marks at citation [1] and highlighted source paragraph. Extremely clean grid and clear task state. This is an application, not a printed article or decorative typographic poster.
